items.label: Small Light Electric Motorcycle (小型輕型機車)
items.value: Curb weight < 70 kg (incl. battery); Power < 1.34 HP (1 kW); Max speed ≤ 45 km/h; Tire diameter 300–420 mm; 0 passengers allowed (single-rider only)

items.label: Regular Light Motorcycle (普通輕型機車 / Green Plate)
items.value: Displacement ≤ 50 cc or electric motor > 1.34 HP & ≤ 5 HP; Cargo weight limit: 50 kg; Max 1 passenger (fixed rear seat)

items.label: Regular Heavy Motorcycle (普通重型機車 / White Plate)
items.value: Displacement 50 cc–249 cc or electric motor > 5 HP & ≤ 40 HP; Cargo weight limit: 80 kg; Max 1 passenger (fixed rear seat)

items.label: Large Heavy Motorcycle (Yellow Plate 250–549 cc / Red Plate 550 cc+)
items.value: Follows small passenger car rules; Yellow = Expressways only; Red = Expressways & designated freeways; Driver min age 20 yrs + 1 yr heavy license

items.label: Maximum Cargo Loading Height
items.value: Must not exceed the rider's shoulder height

items.label: Maximum Cargo Loading Width
items.value: Must not exceed 10 cm beyond outer edge of handlebars on each side (total width ≤ handlebars + 20 cm)

items.label: Maximum Cargo Length (Rear Overhang)
items.value: Must not extend more than 0.5 meters (50 cm) beyond the rear wheel axle

items.label: Maximum Cargo Length (Forward Overhang)
items.value: Must not extend forward beyond the rear of the seat

items.label: Maximum Overall Vehicle Height
items.value: Overall motorcycle height must not exceed 2.0 meters

items.label: Pillion Passenger Seating Rule
items.value: Must sit astride facing forward on fixed rear seat; Sitting sideways (側坐) is strictly prohibited

items.label: Carrying Cargo While Carrying a Passenger
items.value: Prohibited to carry additional cargo when carrying a passenger (small personal hand-carried items exempt)

items.label: Carrying Children on Front Footrest
items.value: Strictly prohibited to carry children, babies, or pets on the front floorboard/footrest

items.label: Turn Signal Light Color Standard
items.value: Turn signal indicator lights must be ORANGE (not red or yellow)

items.label: Headlight Standard
items.value: Must include both High Beam (遠光燈) and Low Beam (近光燈)

category: 🔧 2. Mechanical Maintenance, Tires, Battery & Inspection Rules

items.label: Normal Exhaust Smoke Color
items.value: Colorless / transparent (indicates proper gasoline combustion)

items.label: Black Exhaust Smoke Cause
items.value: Incomplete gasoline combustion (overly rich fuel-air mixture, clogged air filter, or faulty carburetor/injector)

items.label: Bluish-White Exhaust Smoke Cause
items.value: Burning engine oil inside combustion chamber (worn piston rings or leaking valve stem seals)

items.label: White Steam in Cold Weather
items.value: Normal condensation of water vapor in cold exhaust system; dissipates quickly

items.label: Primary Greenhouse Gas in Motorcycle Emissions
items.value: Carbon dioxide (CO₂)

items.label: Battery Terminal Maintenance
items.value: Apply grease / Vaseline to battery terminals to prevent corrosion and oxidation

items.label: Battery Fluid Replenishment
items.value: Replenish only with Distilled Water (never tap water, mineral water, or acid)

items.label: Air Filter Purpose
items.value: Filters sand, dust, and abrasives from intake air to prevent cylinder wall and piston scoring

items.label: Brake Lever Free Play
items.value: 1 to 2 cm (10–20 mm) of lever travel before braking engagement begins

items.label: Spark Plug Gap
items.value: 0.6 to 0.7 mm

items.label: Minimum Tire Tread Depth
items.value: 0.8 mm (must replace immediately when tread reaches wear indicator bump on tire shoulder)

items.label: Maximum Recommended Tire Age
items.value: No more than 6 years from manufacture date

items.label: Tire Date Code Decoding (e.g. MMD1213)
items.value: 1213 = 12th week of the year 2013 (first 2 digits = week, last 2 digits = year)

items.label: Tire Specification Code (e.g. 3.50-10-8PR)
items.value: 3.50 = 3.5 inch tire width; 10 = 10 inch rim diameter; 8PR = 8 Ply Rating structural carcass strength

items.label: Under-Inflated Tire Symptoms
items.value: Wear on both outer shoulder edges + increased fuel consumption + heavy sluggish steering

items.label: Over-Inflated Tire Symptoms
items.value: Wear along center rib + reduced road grip + harsh bumpy ride damaging shock absorbers

items.label: Tire Pressure Measurement Condition
items.value: Always measure tire pressure when tires are COLD before riding

items.label: Transfer of Ownership Inspection
items.value: Mandatory temporary inspection if motorcycle is > 5 years old from manufacture date

items.label: Temporary Out-of-Service (報停) Max Period
items.value: Up to 1 year maximum

items.label: Severe Accident Repair Inspection
items.value: Requires Temporary Inspection (臨時檢驗) after repair before returning to road use

items.label: Long-Term Parked Motorcycle Maintenance
items.value: Start engine and idle for 3–5 minutes at least once every week

category: 🚑 3. Emergency First Aid, CPR Sequence & Bleeding Protocols

items.label: CPR Life-Support Protocol Sequence
items.value: Call 119 → Call for AED → C (Compressions) → A (Airway) → B (Breathing) → D (Defibrillation with AED)

items.label: Chest Compression Rate
items.value: 100 to 120 compressions per minute (approx. 100/min)

items.label: Chest Compression Depth (Adult)
items.value: 5 to 6 cm at center of sternum between nipples

items.label: Compression to Ventilation Ratio
items.value: 30 compressions to 2 rescue breaths (30:2) for adult CPR

items.label: Maximum Allowable CPR Interruption
items.value: Must not exceed 10 seconds (for pulse checks, breaths, or AED pads)

items.label: CPR Re-Evaluation Frequency
items.value: Check pulse and breathing effectiveness every 2 minutes (approx. 5 cycles of 30:2)

items.label: Airway & Breathing Check Duration
items.value: Check breathing and airway for no more than 10 seconds

items.label: Cardiac Arrest Brain Damage Window
items.value: CPR must begin within 4 to 6 minutes to prevent irreversible hypoxic brain damage

items.label: Unconscious Victim with Normal Breathing
items.value: Place in Recovery Position (side-lying) to keep airway clear and allow fluid drainage

items.label: Suspected Cervical / Spine Trauma Airway
items.value: Use Jaw-Thrust Maneuver without tilting the head or extending the neck

items.label: Choking / Heimlich Maneuver Hand Position
items.value: Place clenched fist midway between navel and lower sternum (xiphoid process), thrust upward & inward

items.label: Arterial Bleeding Characteristics
items.value: Bright red oxygenated blood spurting pulsatile under high pressure → Immediate direct pressure / tourniquet

items.label: Venous Bleeding Characteristics
items.value: Dark red blood flowing steadily in continuous stream → Direct pressure with sterile dressing

items.label: Capillary Bleeding Characteristics
items.value: Slow reddish oozing from surface abrasions → Clean with normal saline and apply sterile dressing

items.label: Tourniquet Protocol
items.value: Record exact time applied; briefly loosen every 15 to 20 minutes to prevent limb tissue necrosis

items.label: Severe Burn Management (5 Steps)
items.value: Rinse (cool running water 15–30 min), Remove loose clothing (never tear stuck cloth), Soak, Cover, Send to hospital

items.label: Compound Fracture with Bleeding
items.value: Stop the bleeding first; never attempt to push protruding bone fragments back into the flesh

items.label: Chemical Skin Exposure Treatment
items.value: Immediately rinse affected area with copious amounts of running clean water (do not neutralize with chemicals)

category: 🍷 4. Alcohol Limits, DUI Penalties & License Sanctions

items.label: Administrative Fine BAC Threshold
items.value: 0.15 mg/L breath alcohol (or 0.03% blood alcohol)

items.label: Criminal Public Endangerment BAC Threshold
items.value: 0.25 mg/L breath alcohol (or 0.05% blood alcohol) → up to 3 yrs imprisonment + fine up to NT$300,000

items.label: 1st Motorcycle DUI Offense
items.value: NT$15,000 to NT$90,000 fine + 1 to 2-year license suspension + motorcycle impounded on the spot

items.label: 2nd Motorcycle DUI within 10 Years
items.value: NT$90,000 flat fine + 3-year license revocation + motorcycle impounded + public disclosure of name and photo

items.label: 3rd+ Motorcycle DUI within 10 Years
items.value: Previous fine + NT$90,000 additional per offense + license revocation + vehicle impounded

items.label: Refusal of Breathalyzer Test (1st Offense)
items.value: NT$180,000 flat fine + immediate license revocation (3-year reapplication ban) + vehicle impounded + lecture

items.label: Refusal of Breathalyzer Test (2nd Offense in 10 Yrs)
items.value: NT$360,000 flat fine (+ NT$180,000 for each subsequent refusal) + 5-year reapplication ban

items.label: DUI Causing Serious Injury or Death
items.value: Permanent driver license revocation (lifetime ban from retaking test) + vehicle confiscated

items.label: DUI or Unlicensed Riding Causing Injury/Death
items.value: Criminal penalties legally increased by up to ONE-HALF (+1/2 or 1.5x sentence)

items.label: Accumulating 12 Demerit Points within 1 Year
items.value: Driver's license suspended for 2 months

items.label: Lending Driver's License to Others
items.value: 3-month driver's license suspension for both lender and unauthorized rider

items.label: Damaged / Unidentifiable Driver's License
items.value: Apply for a replacement license (do not need to retake driving test)

category: 💰 5. Complete Traffic Fines & Demerit Points Matrix

items.label: Helmet Not Worn / Unfastened Chin Strap
items.value: NT$500 flat fine

items.label: Operating Handheld Mobile Phone While Riding
items.value: NT$1,000 flat fine

items.label: Running Red Light (Traffic Signal)
items.value: NT$1,800 to NT$5,400 fine + 3 demerit points

items.label: Crossing Stop Line on Red (Front Wheel Over Line)
items.value: NT$900 to NT$1,800 fine + 1 demerit point

items.label: Failure to Make Two-Stage Left Turn (Hook-Turn)
items.value: NT$600 to NT$1,200 fine + 1 demerit point

items.label: Riding in Designated 'No Motorcycles' (禁行機車) Lane
items.value: NT$600 to NT$1,800 fine + 1 demerit point

items.label: Failure to Yield to Pedestrians on Crosswalk
items.value: NT$1,200 to NT$6,000 fine + 3 demerit points + road safety lecture

items.label: Failure to Yield to Emergency Vehicles (Ambulance/Fire)
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$90,000 fine + DRIVER LICENSE REVOCATION

items.label: Unlicensed Motorcycle Riding
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$24,000 fine + prohibited from riding + vehicle impounded

items.label: Speeding ≤ 40 km/h Over Limit
items.value: NT$1,200 to NT$2,400 fine + 1 demerit point

items.label: Excessive Speeding (≥ 40 km/h Over Limit - Dangerous Driving)
items.value: NT$6,000 to NT$36,000 fine + 6 months license plate suspension + 3 demerit points + lecture

items.label: Turning or Changing Lanes Without Turn Signal
items.value: NT$1,200 to NT$3,600 fine + 1 demerit point

items.label: Opening Car Door Dangerously / Unsafe Dooring
items.value: NT$2,400 to NT$4,800 fine

items.label: Hit and Run in Property-Damage-Only Accident
items.value: NT$1,000 to NT$3,000 fine + 1 to 3 months driver license suspension

items.label: Hit and Run Causing Injury or Death
items.value: Driver license revoked + 1 to 7 years imprisonment (Criminal Code Art. 185-4)

items.label: Failing to Move Vehicle in Minor Non-Injury Accident
items.value: NT$600 to NT$1,800 fine (if vehicle is operable and obstructs traffic)

items.label: Speed Limit - Alleys & Roads Without Center Lines
items.value: 30 km/h

items.label: Speed Limit - Roads With Center Lines but No Speed Signs
items.value: 50 km/h

items.label: Speed Limit - Slow Lanes & Designated Curved / Mountain Sections
items.value: 40 km/h

items.label: Speed vs. Braking Distance Physics
items.value: Braking distance ∝ Speed² (Doubling speed from 30 to 60 km/h quadruples braking distance 4x)

items.label: Speed vs. Fatality Risk (OECD Research)
items.value: Increasing impact speed from 30 km/h to 50 km/h increases motorcycle fatality rate sharply from 10% to ~80%

items.label: Turn Signal Advance Distance
items.value: Must activate turn signal at least 30 meters before turning or changing lanes

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way #1 (Straight vs Turning)
items.value: Straight-going vehicle has absolute right-of-way over turning vehicle

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way #2 (Left vs Right Turn)
items.value: Left-turning vehicle must yield to oncoming Right-turning vehicle at same intersection

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way #3 (Uncontrolled / Equal Intersections)
items.value: Vehicle on LEFT must yield to vehicle approaching from the RIGHT

items.label: Intersection Right-of-Way #4 (Main vs Branch Road)
items.value: Branch road (fewer lanes / stop/yield sign) must yield to Main road (more lanes / through road)

items.label: Roundabout Right-of-Way
items.value: Entering vehicles must yield to vehicles already circulating inside the roundabout

items.label: Two-Stage Left Turn (Hook-Turn / 兩段式左轉)
items.value: Mandatory when hook-turn sign posted OR road has 3+ fast lanes OR inner lane marked 'No Motorcycles'

items.label: U-Turns Prohibited Sections
items.value: Prohibited on double solid yellow lines, single solid yellow line, on bridges, in tunnels, underpasses, roundabouts, or where left turns prohibited

items.label: Riding Downhill Mountain Road
items.value: Strictly prohibited to turn off engine or coast in neutral (must use lower gear for engine braking)

category: 🎬 7. Hazard Perception, Road Markings & Defensive Riding

items.label: Double Solid Yellow Lines
items.value: Divides opposing traffic lanes; strictly prohibited to cross, overtake, or make U-turns

items.label: Single Solid White Line
items.value: Roadway edge line (outer side is shoulder) or lane boundary prohibiting lane changes

items.label: Double Solid White Lines
items.value: Prohibits changing lanes between lanes traveling in the same direction

items.label: Yellow Diagonal Striped Area
items.value: Painted obstacle zone / safety island; strictly prohibited to ride into or park on

items.label: Passing Stopped Public Bus
items.value: Slow down, leave wide lateral buffer, anticipate hidden pedestrians stepping out from front of bus

items.label: Wet Asphalt & Road Markings (Manholes / Paint)
items.value: Friction coefficient drops sharply when wet; avoid hard braking or severe lean angles on paint and metal covers

items.label: Large Vehicle Turning (Inner Wheel Off-Tracking)
items.value: Rear wheels cut significantly inside front wheels; stay completely clear of turning large trucks/buses

items.label: Parked Car Door Opening (Dooring Hazard)
items.value: Maintain at least 0.5 to 1.0 meter safety buffer from parked cars along roadside

items.label: Motorcycle Braking Technique (Normal Stop)
items.value: Apply front brake (~70% force) and rear brake (~30% force) simultaneously in a straight line

items.label: Riding in Heavy Rain / Dense Fog
items.value: Turn on low-beam headlights, reduce speed by 20–30%, and increase following distance to double normal
